environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a public subnet. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection layer. The application serves HTTPS directly via nginx reverse proxy to Flask on port 8080. Database file is local on EBS volume.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener on 443 forwarding to instance port 443
config.reverse_proxy: nginx 1.20 proxy_pass to 127.0.0.1:8080, no request filtering
